Sri Preethaji addresses this directly in her discourse on the nature of consciousness:

**Sri Preethaji** · [AB-t5CoxMHM](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AB-t5CoxMHM&t=3s)

To us every human experience is sacred, we see that there is one human experience, one humanity. That is what Ekam means, it means oneness. Ekam is an enlightened state of consciousness where you are awake to the oneness of our existence. We are one with all forms of life. We are one with the universe. When you are not established in this great spiritual realization that we are one, your actions and behavior cause division and conflict.

Sri Krishnaji further deepens this understanding:

**Sri Krishnaji** · [88NOQTz5_yI](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=88NOQTz5_yI&t=229s)

Your awakening is the only solution to stem the further birthing of problems and the dissolution of existing challenges. And the collective awakening of human consciousness is the only enduring panacea for all of world problems. That is why our single most important mission is individual enlightenment and collective awakening of humankind. We belong to Mukti Sampradaya and it is our mission to awaken 74 ,000 people into Sampoorna jivan muktas or total liberated beings. For when 0 .001 % of human population is enlightened, the balance tilts in human consciousness towards compassion and oneness. This has been the mission of my parents Shri Amma and Shri Bhagawan and five generations of sages who have gone before them and Shri Preethaji and I intend to fulfill the sacred mission of great liberation of humanity in our own lifetimes.

**Sri Preethaji** · [0ypG1mlekNY](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0ypG1mlekNY&t=4s)

Today, I want to teach you how to make luck happen. Kublai Khan, the famous Mongol general, invaded Japan around 1274 AD. He invaded with 20 ,000 soldiers on 500 ships.

---

Me, God is not a person. This God consciousness is an incredible field of intelligence. As I am talking to you, I see this magnificent blackbird. It's carrying pieces of a garden lizard she has killed to feed her babies. There is such intelligence in that bird. She knows how to build a nest for her babies, feed them and she will do this for the entire summer. And before the rains begin, her babies would have grown enough to fend for themselves. This is an intelligent bird. I am sitting under this 300 -year -old mango tree. An extraordinary intelligence manifests in this mango tree. If she gives mangoes one year, the next year she rests. If too many worms eat upon her leaves, she allows the fruit bats to alight upon her. The fruit bats eat the worms and fly away There is so much intelligence From an ordinary mind state You would see an intelligent tree An intelligent human being An intelligent bird Intelligent grass But as a mystic I see one big field of intelligence This field is connected entity Inseparable in consciousness This field This intelligence Is present in your body is present in your heart. You could actually access it in your heart. It is possible to connect with the universal intelligence that is imminent in every bit of this universe. You can connect to this all -pervasive being of intelligence. This intelligence is within everyone and everything. It is like a vast infinite web with infinite nodal points and And each nodal point is you, me and everything else. The nature of this web is, it connects everything to everything else. Oneness is its very nature and essence.

Sri Preethaji speaks further to this truth:

**Sri Preethaji** · [BZDXIQwOPdU](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BZDXIQwOPdU&t=691s)

You become an entrepreneur who makes decisions without succumbing to anxiety. You become a parent who can relate to one's child without succumbing to worry. You become a partner who can truly care without judgements.

**Sri Krishnaji** · [ACvOem_B-Ek](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ACvOem_B-Ek&t=1512s)

The killing and miming often happens with the shield of a noble cause. At the root of all these wars are individuals who are divided and driven by hatred. Every technological advancement and evolutionary leap that we make from hate will not lead us to progress. Driven by hate and greed, we will invent more destructive methods for war and not for peace. well -being and togetherness. Hence if we want a peaceful beautiful world that is a safe heaven for our children and their children then we have to bring about an awakening in our consciousness. We need to move from hatred and division to peace in our consciousness as individuals, as families, as communities, when we live and relate with one another from peace consciousness, we can create a new destiny for the world, where wars and battles will not be furthered anymore. Wars should end. Peace between the nations is the responsibility of our political leaders. We need leaders who are driven by consciousness that looks beyond them into the future. It is the the responsibility of each and every one of us. Let us listen to a real -life story.

results.response: Sri Preethaji & Sri Krishnaji are the founders of the O&O Academy, a philosophy and meditation school dedicated to transforming consciousness. They are entrepreneurs, philosophers, and spiritual teachers who have guided thousands of people worldwide through their retreats and the Ekam World Peace Festival. Their teachings emphasize the integration of inner transformation with external success, showing that true happiness and fulfillment are not found solely in wealth, fame, or relationships but in living in a Beautiful State of consciousness. They authored *The Four Sacred Secrets for Love and Prosperity*, offering practical wisdom for living a life of joy and peace. Their work extends into charitable initiatives, such as the Oneness Changemakers foundation, which provides transformational education, and the Loca Foundation, which uplifts communities in need. Their mission is to awaken individuals and collectively heal humanity through compassionate action.
